answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 52 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The zenith register is checked at draw time, saffron lists the eligible set, and grove seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 52 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 15 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
